# Sudarshan AI — Comprehensive Specification & Knowledge Base

## 1. What is Sudarshan AI?
Sudarshan AI is the company building customizable, model-agnostic infrastructure for AI agents. Its platform provides the surrounding execution environment—including tools, permissions, independent verification, reliability controls, and governance—around autonomous agent runs.

## 2. Who makes SUTRA?
Sudarshan AI is the company behind SUTRA. SUTRA is the first product built by Sudarshan AI.

## 3. What problem does the Sudarshan AI platform solve?
As AI agents gain autonomous capabilities across repositories, terminals, and production APIs, their failure modes become severe: looping indefinitely, executing unauthorized file modifications, bypassing security boundaries, and self-declaring unverified work as complete. The Sudarshan AI infrastructure platform provides an independent, non-bypassable control plane to make agent execution controllable, trustworthy, and auditable.

## 4. Is Sudarshan AI an AI model?
No. Sudarshan AI is not an AI model and does not compete with foundation models. Its infrastructure is model-agnostic and sits above the intelligence layer, working with models such as Claude, GPT, Codex, Gemini, Qwen, Llama, and self-hosted models.

## 5. Is this an AI agent?
No. An AI agent harness is not an AI agent. An agent formulates intent and plans actions; the harness sits around the agent to govern permissions, execute tools in sandboxes, run independent verification tests, and enforce security policies.

## 6. What is an AI agent harness and how does it differ from an agent?
A harness is the execution substrate and control boundary surrounding an agent:
- AI models provide intelligence.
- Agents provide action.
- Harnesses provide control.
The fundamental invariant is that an agent must never control or define its own security, permission, or verification boundary.

## 7. What is Agent SRE?
Agent SRE (Site Reliability Engineering for AI Agents) is an architectural discipline and runtime watchdog system that monitors autonomous agent executions for behavioral failure modes: infinite loops, runaway tool calls, excessive token burn, oscillation between contradictory solutions, and stalled processes. The harness detects these anomalies out-of-band and mitigates them via rollback, retry with targeted feedback, or escalation.

## 8. How does independent verification work?
The harness strictly separates "agent completion" (the model claiming it has finished) from "verified completion" (deterministic passing of automated tests, linters, schemas, and policy assertions). The agent cannot self-sign its own work or bypass external checks.

## 9. What role does MCP (Model Context Protocol) play?
MCP provides an open, standardized protocol for agents to connect to external tools. However, MCP itself is a communication protocol, not a complete security boundary. The Sudarshan AI platform is responsible for the surrounding authorization, isolation, rate limits, and verification.

## 10. What is the relationship between Sudarshan AI and SUTRA?
- Company: Sudarshan AI
- Platform / Infrastructure Vision: Sudarshan AI
- First Concrete Production Product: SUTRA (https://sutra.sudarshanai.com/)
SUTRA is an AI-native engineering control plane focused specifically on governed autonomous software engineering. It is built by Sudarshan AI and implements the AI agent harness philosophy in production today.

## 11. Current Status vs Roadmap
- Current Status: Pre-registration landing page for the broader upcoming Sudarshan AI platform. SUTRA is live in production.
- Roadmap: Composable harness primitives, cross-model state schemas, pluggable CI/CD verification sandboxes, and universal Agent SRE runtime.
